name: Gabapentin
description: A ligand at the alpha-2-delta subunit of voltage-gated calcium channels, approved for postherpetic neuralgia and as adjunctive therapy for partial seizures. Off-label use for sleep and anxiety is widespread.

systems.note: Alpha-2-delta ligand action; the labelled indications and the basis of off-label sedative use.
Cleared unchanged by the kidney; dose adjustment is labelled and accumulation causes toxicity.
DRESS with hepatic involvement is labelled; the drug is not hepatically metabolised.

monitors.why: Cleared unchanged renally; labelled dose adjustment depends on this value.
Labelled suicidal behaviour signal for antiepileptic drugs.
